name: ai-grind
description: Marketplace for the devtools-mcp performance-engineering plugin — a unified MCP server plus a bundled skills library (profiling, debugging, PowerShell, code-intel). Also ships project-map, which templates any project for coding agents.

plugins.name: devtools-mcp
plugins.description: Unified perf-engineering MCP server (Valgrind/LLDB/DTrace/perf/ETW/VTune/JVM/CDB/Python/Node + build systems, flame graphs, viz terminal, progress tracker) with the full skills library bundled.

plugins.name: ai-grind-skills
plugins.description: Cross-platform ai-grind skills, commands and agents only. No MCP server, so it never collides with an HTTP devtools-mcp server.

plugins.name: ai-grind-windows
plugins.description: Windows-only ai-grind skills: PowerShell (pwsh-*), CDB crash debugging, ETW profiling. Install on Windows machines only.

plugins.name: project-map
plugins.description: Template any project for coding agents in one command: CLAUDE.md per area, a PROJECT_MAP.md that records what/where/why, engineering principles, and a local SQLite FTS5/BM25 index (optional embeddings) as CLI + MCP tools, with agent notes that go stale when their files change.
